name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: NHC expects no Atlantic tropical cyclone to form in the 7 days from 23 Nov; the 2026 season ends on 30 Nov
state: The National Hurricane Center's Atlantic outlook issued at 07:00 EST on 23 Nov covers the North Atlantic, Caribbean Sea and Gulf, and says no tropical cyclone formation is expected in the next seven days (NHC). GDACS's cyclone feed for 17 to 24 Nov lists only Xavier in the South Pacific and Akvan in the North Indian Ocean, both at green, with no Atlantic system (GDACS). With nothing threatening land within five days and the season ending on 30 Nov, the level stays Normal.
for_you: No Atlantic storm is active or forecast. Anyone travelling to the Caribbean or the US Gulf coast can check the National Hurricane Center and FCDO travel advice before departure.
rubric_hit: No hurricane active or threatening land within 5 days; NHC expects no formation in 7 days (23 Nov)
